prompt_cards.purpose: Creating a single “source of truth” log for facts, assumptions, and open questions
Making a clear recommendation with explicit criteria and trade-offs
Defining KPIs clearly (formula, unit, owner, cadence)
Comparing 2–6 options using explicit evaluation criteria and scoring
Building a pricing model from explicit assumptions (no fabricated market data)
Building a milestone plan with dependencies and acceptance criteria
Creating a practical risk register with clear mitigations and owners
Weekly/monthly stakeholder updates that are crisp and decision-oriented
